reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass this on to Ruth or anyone else. Since it came from Mateo and you shared it with me privately, it stays between us unless you decide to bring Ruth in yourself.

If you want Ruth briefed, the cleanest route is to talk to her directly or ask Mateo to include her. I can also help you draft a note for her, but I'd send it from you, not from me.
